ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd.'s Board approved its FY2025-26 Annual Report and the re-appointment of two independent directors for five-year terms, indicating routine governance and stability. The most significant announcement is the appointment of Mr. Amit Dangi, an existing Whole-time Director, as the Interim Chief Financial Officer (CFO). While this ensures continuity during the search for a permanent CFO, it signals a temporary leadership structure in a crucial financial role, which warrants observation for the stability of the finance function.
